info.name: D-ID Agents Knowledge API
info.description: API for creating and managing interactive real-time AI agents that combine digital avatar streaming with large language models, RAG-based knowledge bases, and custom tools. Supports WebRTC and LiveKit-powered streaming sessions, conversation memory, chat export, and integration with third-party LLM providers. Enables face-to-face AI conversations at scale.
